name: Umami Analytics
tagline: Umami is a simple, fast, privacy-focused alternative to Google Analytics.
description:
# Umami

## What is Umami?

Umami is an open-source, privacy-focused web analytics tool that serves as an alternative to Google Analytics. It provides essential insights into website traffic, user behavior, and performance, all while prioritizing data privacy.

Unlike many traditional analytics platforms, Umami does not collect or store personal data, avoiding the need for cookies, and is GDPR and PECR compliant.

Designed to be lightweight and easy to set up, Umami can be self-hosted, giving users full control over their data.

## Getting Started

A detailed getting started guide can be found at [umami.is/docs](https://umami.is/docs/).

## Default credentials

Username: `admin`
Password: `umami`

questions.label: Web port
questions.hint: The port on this server that opens the app.

compose:
services:
  umami-analytics:
    container_name: umami-analytics
    image: ghcr.io/umami-software/umami:3.4.1
    restart: unless-stopped
    ports:
      - ${APP_PORT}:3000
    environment:
      - DATABASE_URL=postgresql://umami:${UMAMI_ANALYTICS_DB_PASSWORD}@umami-analytics-db:5432/umami-analytics-db
      - DATABASE_TYPE=postgresql
      - APP_SECRET=${UMAMI_ANALYTICS_APP_SECRET}
  umami-analytics-db:
    container_name: umami-analytics-db
    image: postgres:15-alpine
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      - POSTGRES_DB=umami-analytics-db
      - POSTGRES_USER=umami
      - POSTGRES_PASSWORD=${UMAMI_ANALYTICS_DB_PASSWORD}
    volumes:
      - ${APP_DATA_DIR}/data/db:/var/lib/postgresql/data
